'''Crisis''' was a division of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. Formed when needed, Crisis branches were created in response to hot spots that arose across the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Crisis was in constant contact with the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], and relied on [[External Communications]] facilities to contact [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]]
or even the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
